name: Insurance
description: Industry vocabulary only. Not coverage advice.

hasDefinedTerm.name: premium
hasDefinedTerm.description: The amount paid for insurance coverage, usually monthly or annually.

hasDefinedTerm.name: deductible
hasDefinedTerm.description: The amount an insured pays out of pocket before coverage begins to pay.

hasDefinedTerm.name: copay
hasDefinedTerm.description: A fixed amount paid for a covered service, separate from the deductible.

hasDefinedTerm.name: coinsurance
hasDefinedTerm.description: The percentage of a covered cost the insured pays after the deductible is met.

hasDefinedTerm.name: out-of-pocket maximum
hasDefinedTerm.description: The annual ceiling on what an insured pays before coverage pays everything else.

hasDefinedTerm.name: policy limit
hasDefinedTerm.description: The maximum an insurer will pay under a policy.

hasDefinedTerm.name: rider
hasDefinedTerm.description: An add-on modifying the coverage of a base policy.

hasDefinedTerm.name: exclusion
hasDefinedTerm.description: A circumstance a policy explicitly does not cover.

hasDefinedTerm.name: underwriting
hasDefinedTerm.description: Assessing the risk of insuring someone and setting terms accordingly.

hasDefinedTerm.name: actuary
hasDefinedTerm.description: A specialist who models risk and prices it using statistical methods.

hasDefinedTerm.name: loss ratio
hasDefinedTerm.description: Claims paid as a proportion of premiums collected.

hasDefinedTerm.name: combined ratio
hasDefinedTerm.description: Claims plus expenses as a proportion of premiums. Below 100% means underwriting profit.

hasDefinedTerm.name: claim
hasDefinedTerm.description: A request for payment under the terms of a policy.

hasDefinedTerm.name: adjuster
hasDefinedTerm.description: The person who investigates a claim and determines what the insurer owes.

hasDefinedTerm.name: subrogation
hasDefinedTerm.description: An insurer pursuing a third party responsible for a loss it has paid out.

hasDefinedTerm.name: first-party claim
hasDefinedTerm.description: A claim made by the policyholder against their own insurer.

hasDefinedTerm.name: third-party claim
hasDefinedTerm.description: A claim made against a policyholder by someone else.

hasDefinedTerm.name: reinsurance
hasDefinedTerm.description: Insurance bought by insurers to cap their own exposure.

hasDefinedTerm.name: captive insurer
hasDefinedTerm.description: An insurance subsidiary formed to cover its parent company's risks.

hasDefinedTerm.name: broker
hasDefinedTerm.description: An intermediary representing the buyer when placing coverage.

hasDefinedTerm.name: agent
hasDefinedTerm.description: An intermediary representing the insurer when selling coverage.

hasDefinedTerm.name: carrier
hasDefinedTerm.description: The company actually bearing the insured risk.

hasDefinedTerm.name: open enrollment
hasDefinedTerm.description: The defined window during which coverage may be selected or changed.

hasDefinedTerm.name: qualifying life event
hasDefinedTerm.description: A change permitting a coverage election outside open enrollment.

hasDefinedTerm.name: in-network
hasDefinedTerm.description: A provider with a negotiated contract with the insurer.

hasDefinedTerm.name: EOB
hasDefinedTerm.description: Explanation of benefits. The statement showing what was billed, covered, and owed. Not a bill.

hasDefinedTerm.name: formulary
hasDefinedTerm.description: The list of medications a health plan covers, usually organized in cost tiers.

hasDefinedTerm.name: umbrella policy
hasDefinedTerm.description: Additional liability coverage sitting above the limits of underlying policies.

hasDefinedTerm.name: named perils
hasDefinedTerm.description: A policy covering only the specific risks it lists.

hasDefinedTerm.name: all risk
hasDefinedTerm.description: A policy covering any risk except those explicitly excluded.

hasDefinedTerm.name: replacement cost
hasDefinedTerm.description: Coverage paying to replace property without deducting for depreciation.

hasDefinedTerm.name: actual cash value
hasDefinedTerm.description: Coverage paying replacement cost minus depreciation.

hasDefinedTerm.name: proof of loss
hasDefinedTerm.description: The documentation an insured submits to substantiate a claim.

hasDefinedTerm.name: lapse
hasDefinedTerm.description: Coverage ending because premiums were not paid.

hasDefinedTerm.name: grace period
hasDefinedTerm.description: A window after a missed payment during which coverage continues.

hasDefinedTerm.name: risk pool
hasDefinedTerm.description: The group across which insured risk is spread.

hasDefinedTerm.name: adverse selection
hasDefinedTerm.description: When higher-risk people are disproportionately likely to buy coverage, pushing prices up.

hasDefinedTerm.name: moral hazard
hasDefinedTerm.description: The tendency to take more risk once insured against its consequences.

hasDefinedTerm.name: insurtech
hasDefinedTerm.description: Technology-led entrants and tools reshaping insurance distribution and underwriting.

hasDefinedTerm.name: embedded insurance
hasDefinedTerm.description: Coverage offered inside another purchase, such as at checkout.
